Maintenance Procedures
Document No.: P-204-r0a

Procedure: Periodic maintenance

sections_en.text: The first draft of the document was prepared by Eng. Ahmed Sayed Hussein, tested by Eng. Sayed Mohamed Ahmed, approved by Eng. Abdel Azim Hagras, General Manager, endorsed by Eng. Hussein Ahmed El Mahdy, Head of the Stations Sector, and documented by Eng. Gamal Abdel Wahab, Maintenance Procedures Information System Coordinator and Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at the Upper Egypt Electricity Production Company.

rows: Ensure that the unit to be worked on is shut down
Stop the pump and close the discharge valve
Start the standby cooling pump
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority, and the maintenance crew must carry the occupational safety and health category card
Record the names of the workers in the work order and their occupational safety and health categories
Fence off the work area and place the appropriate warning signs
Workers must wear occupational safety and health equipment while carrying out the work, such as the helmet, gloves, masks and protective shoes
Open-end and ring spanner set, sizes 12 to 46 mm
Set of screwdrivers, Allen key set from 4 to 12 mm
Lead hammer, copper hammer and a plastic hammer
Measuring tools: vernier calliper, depth gauge, micrometer set from 0 to 220 mm, dial gauge with stand, measuring tape, spirit level
Fine and coarse sandpaper, silicone, heat-resistant Milcoat
Suspended winch, slings, sanding and grinding machine
Disconnect the motor electrical terminals and lift it from its base
Remove the motor base and lift it
Sling the lower half-coupling of the pump, remove its Allen screw and lift it
Drain the thrust bearing oil and remove the oil chamber cover
Sling the shaft and remove the clearance-setting nut carrying the shaft
Remove the upper cone carrying the bearing
Remove the cover of the last pipe carrying the packing
Disconnect the discharge connection from the line
Sling the pump from the front and back at four points, then lift it with the winch
Place support beams and fasten them well, then load the pump on them
Disconnect the pump discharge by removing the 36 mm bolts, then remove the first pipe below the discharge
Sling the pump and lift it, then remove the support beams, then lift the pump up to the flange of the second pipe
Place the loading beams, fasten them and load the pump on them
Sling the shaft, remove the first coupling, then lift the guide bearing
Sling the pump from pipe No. 2, remove the loading beams and lift the pump
Place the beams below the diffuser, load the pump, then remove pipe No. 2
Sling the shaft, remove the lower coupling, then lift shaft connection No. 2
Sling the last pipe, remove its bolts with the diffuser, then lift it
Remove the diffuser, sling it and take it out
Sling the rotating shaft with the impeller and lift it, then sling the impeller angle and lift it
Inspect the bearing bushes (fixed and rotating) and replace as necessary
Inspect the cone above the impeller
Inspect the impeller angle, secure it and replace as necessary
Close the impeller angle and set the spindle to the zero position
Clean the pipe contact surfaces and wash the bearing
Assemble and adjust the impeller angle, then fit the shaft with the impeller on the stationary part
Fit the diffuser and bolt it to the impeller angle holder, and apply silicone to the contact surfaces
Sling the shaft and take the total clearance by setting the impeller in the lower position then the upper position, then sling the previous assembly, remove the beams and lower the pump
Place the beams and lower the pump, then place the bolts as it approaches the beams, then complete lowering the pump
Fit the lower bearing
Sling the fixed shaft connection, then fit the coupling
Fit the second pipe, tighten the bolts and apply silicone to the top of the contact
Sling the pump, lift the beams and lower the pump, then place the beams
Load the pump on the beams, then fit the last bearing, then sling the shaft connection and fit the last coupling
Lower the last pipe connection, then lower the discharge and secure it
Place the gland-holder cover and the gland cover, then lower the pump, place it on the base and secure it
Fit the cone carrying the thrust bearing
Level the pump horizontally, adjust the total clearance of the pump and adjust the running clearance
Place the motor base and align it with the shaft axis using a holder
Fit the lower half of the coupling, place the motor and measure the coupling clearance
Lift the motor and adjust the coupling clearance by placing or removing shims under the pump base
Level the motor base horizontally by placing shims under it
Bolt the discharge, then bolt the pump base, then the motor base, and align the motor shaft with the pump, then bolt the motor
Place the packing and oil for the thrust bearing
Connect the main motor terminals, then start up for testing
